description: L0 test results in the worktree (Windows 11). Commands: packages/frame-engine: npm run build && node --test test/*.test.mjs; packages/media-bin: node --test test/*.test.mjs; apps/shell/extensions/akari-preview: node --test test/*.test.mjs (after apps/shell npm run build). apps/shell npm run lint exit 0; build:ext and theia build exit 0. Failure sets after the fix are identical to base (Windows-specific existing failures).
